import hashlib
import json
import pathlib
import subprocess
import time

root = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent
repo = root.parents[2]
package = pathlib.Path('O:/winnt')
candidate = root / 'candidate'
results = []

def hashes(path):
    return {entry.name: hashlib.sha256((path / entry.name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
            for entry in candidate.iterdir() if (path / entry.name).is_file()}

expected = hashes(candidate)
assert len(expected) == 8
assert hashes(package) == expected == hashes(repo / 'assets')
driver = root / 'clean-source/build/.ninja/x64/dialog-test-driver.exe'

def run(bits, name, command, marker=None):
    start = time.monotonic()
    try:
        p = subprocess.run([str(driver), '--direct', *map(str, command)],
                           capture_output=True, text=True, errors='replace', timeout=45)
        code, output = p.returncode, p.stdout + p.stderr
        status = 'passed' if code == 0 and (not marker or marker in output) else 'failed'
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired as e:
        code, output, status = None, str(e), 'inconclusive-timeout'
    results.append(dict(bits=bits, name=name, command=list(map(str, command)),
                        exit_code=code, status=status, output=output,
                        seconds=round(time.monotonic()-start, 3)))
    (root/'native-results.json').write_bytes(json.dumps(results, indent=2).encode())
    print(f'{bits} {name}: {status}', flush=True)

plain = '''core-style-font-cache core-style-font-scope core-style-runtime-text-imports
core-style-native core-style-present core-style-present-fault core-style-present-print
core-style-text-metrics core-style-font-pair core-style-bitmap core-style-bitmap-font
core-style-clip core-style-dc-geometry core-style-icon-size core-style-paint-frame
core-style-pixel-dib core-style-pixel-grid core-style-scroll-resources
core-style-frame-update-dc core-style-menu-owner core-theme-track
core-dc-failure core-menu-dispatch core-control-present core-win16-control-link
core-win16-window-link core-win16-common-link core-win16-layout core-win16-palette
core-win16-control-scope core-uwp-frame_layout core-uwp-frame-hidden
core-status-font-stock core-status-font-isolation core-font'''.split()
for bits, arch in [(32,'x86'),(64,'x64')]:
    tree = root / 'clean-source/build/.ninja' / arch
    dll = package / f'ntw16s{bits}.dll'
    for name in plain:
        run(bits,name,[tree/(name+'.exe')])
    run(bits,'abi-published',[tree/'core-abi.exe',dll])
    for mode in ['scope','cancel']:
        run(bits,'theme-'+mode,[tree/'core-theme-track.exe',mode])
    run(bits,'frames',[tree/'core-frames.exe','--private-worker'])
    run(bits,'font96',[tree/'core-font.exe','--dpi96'],'FONT20 PASS')
    run(bits,'vb-font',[tree/'core-vb-font.exe','--private-worker',tree/'vb-fixture/MSVBVM60.dll'])
    run(bits,'global-vb-text',[tree/'core-global-vb-text.exe','--private-worker',tree/'vb-global-fixture/MSVBVM60.dll'])
    for mode in ['bare','bare-aware','styled','styled-aware']:
        command=[tree/'core-vb.exe','--child',tree/'vb-fixture/MSVBVM60.dll',mode]
        if mode.startswith('styled'):
            command=[package/'run16s.exe','--wait',*command]
        run(bits,'vb-'+mode,command)
    for family in ['tab-controls','tab-controls-v5','header-v5','header-v6']:
        for mode in ['', 'aware']:
            command=[tree/('core-'+family+'.exe'),'--private-worker',dll]
            if mode: command.append(mode)
            run(bits,family+'-'+(mode or 'ordinary'),command)
    for name in ['core-vcl-status-simple','core-status-font-stock-live']:
        run(bits,name,[package/'run16s.exe','--wait',tree/(name+'.exe'),
                      '--private-worker',tree/'vcl-status-module-fixture.dll'])
    for aware in [False, True]:
        command=[package/'run16s.exe','--wait',tree/'core-vcl-popup-scope.exe',
                 '--private-worker',tree/'vcl-popup-wrong-owner.dll']
        if aware: command.append('--aware')
        run(bits,'popup-'+str(aware),command,'VCL_POPUP_SCOPE_OK')
    for family in ['progress-v5','progress-v6']:
        run(bits,family,[tree/('core-'+family+'.exe'),'--private-worker',package/'run16s.exe'])
assert hashes(package) == expected == hashes(repo/'assets')
print(json.dumps({'calls':len(results),'passed':sum(r['status']=='passed' for r in results),
                  'unpassed':[r['name'] for r in results if r['status']!='passed']}),flush=True)

driver=r/'clean-source/build/.ninja/x64/dialog-test-driver.exe'
out=[]
for label,exe,dll in [('S12',baseline/'core-header-v5.exe',baseline/'ntw16s32.dll'),

        row=dict(label=label,command=command,exit_code=None,output=str(e),seconds=time.monotonic()-t)
    out.append(row)
    (r/'header-control-results.json').write_bytes(json.dumps(out,indent=2).encode())

hashes={p.name:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in before.iterdir()}
assert all(hashlib.sha256((baseline/n).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==h for n,h in hashes.items())
